approach: Teach grammatical gender as a property of every noun, the -o / -a rule that covers most nouns, and the habit of learning each noun with its article.
coverage: Every Spanish noun is masculine or feminine, including things
Most nouns ending in -o are masculine: el libro, el amigo
Most nouns ending in -a are feminine: la casa, la amiga
el goes with masculine nouns, la with feminine nouns
For people, -o / -a often marks a man or a woman: el niño, la niña
Gender of things is grammar, not meaning: la mesa is not "female"
Learn every noun with its article: el libro, la casa

data.anchor: Every Spanish noun is masculine or feminine; most nouns ending in -o are masculine (el) and most ending in -a are feminine (la).
prerequisites: el libro, el carro, el amigo: masculine.
la casa, la mesa, la amiga: feminine.
Gender is a grammar label, not a meaning: a table is not female.
Nouns ending in other letters must be learned one by one: el café, la noche.

blocks.purpose: Warns against reading gender as meaning.

cautions.title: Things have gender too
cautions.detail: A table is la mesa and a book is el libro. Nothing about the object is male or female; the word simply belongs to one group.

cautions.title: Not every ending tells you
cautions.detail: Words ending in -e or a consonant can be either: el café, la noche, el papel, la ciudad. Learn them with el or la.

blocks.purpose: Targets guessing gender from meaning rather than form.

data.question: Which article goes with "casa" (house)?
choices: it depends on who lives there

trapReasons.0: English links he and she to people, so it seems gender should depend on a person.

data.whyIntuitionFailed: English only marks gender for people and some animals, so learners look for a reason in the meaning.
data.correctReasoning: Casa ends in -a and is feminine: la casa, always, whoever lives there.
data.recoveryTip: Learn the article with the word: la casa.

blocks.purpose: Closes with the rule and the study habit.

data.takeaway: Most -o nouns are masculine (el libro) and most -a nouns feminine (la casa): learn every noun with its article.
